_comment: MCP servers for the ai-dev-team dev environment. Secrets are NOT stored in this file — they are read from the shell environment, which is populated from ~/ai-dev-team/shared/credentials/.env. This means: (1) rotate keys in .env only, (2) never edit this file for a key change, (3) always launch your harness from a shell that has sourced .env. Commands assume `uvx` and `npx` are on your PATH (uv installs to ~/.local/bin).

github._purpose: GitHub official MCP server (repos, issues, PRs, code search, actions). Runs in Docker. Reads GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN from shell env.

polygon._purpose: Polygon.io market data. Reads POLYGON_API_KEY from shell env.

alpaca_backup._purpose: Alpaca trading — paper by default via PAPER=True. Reads ALPACA_* from shell env.

redis._purpose: Redis operations. Reads REDIS_URL from shell env (defaults to redis://localhost:6379).

docker._purpose: Container operations — start/stop, compose, logs. Requires Docker daemon running.

playwright._purpose: Headless-browser automation. First run downloads browsers (~300MB).
